notes.en: Qualified the corrected 1.1.0 package in a real Linux/riscv64 guest: all seven full-verifier checks passed with the required dependency layer and CJK rendering; real PNG, PDF and SVG outputs were checked. The unchanged eighteen-case density battery passed against the retained actual guest PNG and encoded edge cases, including both axes, ambiguous/truncated pre-IDAT metadata and strict non-PNG thresholds. Active denial probes excluded unrelated modules. Raw measured DPI remains visible; only proven integer pHYs quantization affects threshold comparison. Dependencies, tools, capabilities, exporter and golden inputs are unchanged. Component CLI qualification is distinct from App UI and physical-device acceptance.
notes.zh-Hans: 修正后的1.1.0包已在真实Linux/riscv64客体中完成完整验证器七项检查，必需依赖与中文字形渲染均通过，并检查了实际PNG、PDF及SVG输出。未修改的十八项密度检查针对保留的真实客体PNG和编码边界全部通过，覆盖双轴、不明确或截断的IDAT前元数据，以及非PNG严格阈值；无关模块的拒绝探针实际生效。原始实测DPI保持不变，只有已证实的整数pHYs量化影响阈值比较。依赖、工具、能力、导出器与金标准输入均不变。组件CLI鉴定不等于App界面或真机验收。

reviewedPythonPackages.purpose: Figure rendering and PNG/PDF/SVG export through the headless Agg backend; identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-matplotlib (3.10.1+dfsg1)
Numeric array backend for matplotlib and bundled palette/style tooling; identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-numpy (1:2.2.4+ds)
Raster deliverable inspection (image_metadata.py) and RGB TIFF flattening in figure export; identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-pil (11.1.0)
PDF deliverable inspection (page geometry, fonts) in image_metadata.py; identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-pypdf (5.4.0)
